                    My first crystalline glaze and we had good results first time out.                     3 years ago

                                                                                         Deanna Kjorlien I have no experience with granular
                                                                                             manganese, so I don't know if it would dissolve well
                                                                                          enough in the glaze. I've only seen it in glazes where it
                                                                                                           gives a speckled look so that could also be the culprit.



                                                                                                                    Deanna Kjorlien
                                                                                                              3 years ago

Inge Besteman it sieved well 100#mesh. I’ll try again.
                                                                                                              It’s more than likely a mistake I made or a material
                                                                                     issue. I have a lot of test tiles ready! Thank you for your
                                                                          feedback. I appreciate it.



                                                                                                          Faulty Stone
                                                                                 3 years ago

                                                                Deanna Kjorlien Granular Manganese is most often use
                                                                                   inside a clay body to give it a speckle effect instead of
                                                                                            in a glaze. I would probably try doing this recipe again
                                                                         but this time using regular manganese
                                                                               carbonate/oxide/dioxide and it should hopefully give
                                                                   you a colour.



                                                                                     Deanna Kjorlien
                                                                                 3 years ago
